rationale_overall: As of 2023-03-31, all fourteen names on the watchlist have fresh, dated Q4-2022/Q1-2023 evidence that still supports the thesis they were added for: the AI wave is in early buildup (MSFT's Jan-23 OpenAI re-up, GOOGL's Feb-23 Bard reveal, NVDA's data-center revenue still growing YoY, AAPL's services record), the rockets/spacecraft wave is progressing (RKLB's Feb-23 Q4 print showed 88% YoY revenue growth and record backlog), nuclear is advancing through the regulatory pipeline (NuScale's Jan-23 NRC design approval), quantum is still pre-revenue-scale but funded (IONQ's Mar-23 print), the geopolitical/defense wave remains in a steady rearmament buildup (LMT and GD both posted solid Q4-22 results and record backlog; ITA complements the two primes), the tanker/commodity wave is benefiting from Russia-sanctions-driven rerouting (FRO's best quarter in 14 years, Feb-23), and the robotics/demographics-adjacent names (ISRG, ROK) both beat on recent prints. Pass-1 discovery surfaced no un-held ticker with a comparably concrete dated Q1-2023 milestone clearing the guardrails, so no adds. No holding shows a fundamental thesis breach or a peak-enthusiasm signal severe enough to warrant a remove at this early buildup-phase stage, so the watchlist carries over unchanged.
